events.title: Samsung Galaxy S II released
events.summary: Samsung began selling the Samsung Galaxy S II — dual-core Exynos and a slimmer design made it the Android benchmark of 2011.
events.about: The Galaxy S series remained Android's volume flagship counterweight to iPhone. Dual-core exynos and a slimmer design made it the android benchmark of 2011. Developers testing Android builds routinely validated on Galaxy S hardware as the default non-Pixel reference.

narrative.whyChosen: The Samsung Galaxy S II continued Samsung's annual Android flagship cadence.
narrative.whyImportant: Galaxy S devices set the hardware bar millions of Android users and developers encounter.
narrative.problemSolved: Android needed consistent premium hardware for testing flagship features each year.
